attr.title: Deponia
attr.desc: Daedalic's point-and-click comedy adventure. Rufus wants off the junk planet Deponia, and a girl falling out of the sky might be his ticket. The official Linux build runs through box64.
attr.inst: GOG: copy the Linux offline installer (deponia_*.sh) into ports/deponia/gamedata, it is unpacked on first launch. Steam: download both Linux depots of app 214340, 214358 (base) and 214359 (binaries), for example with the Steam console (download_depot 214340 214358 and download_depot 214340 214359), and copy their contents together into ports/deponia/gamedata.
attr.inst_md:
**GOG:** copy the Linux offline installer (`deponia_*.sh`) into `ports/deponia/gamedata`. It is unpacked on first launch, then deleted.

**Steam (app 214340):** the Linux version is two depots, you need both:

- `214358` Linux deponia base (game data)
- `214359` Linux deponia binaries

Download them from the Steam console (`steam://open/console`):

```
download_depot 214340 214358
download_depot 214340 214359
```

or with DepotDownloader: `DepotDownloader -app 214340 -depot 214358 214359 -os linux -username <your Steam name>`.

Copy the contents of both depots together into `ports/deponia/gamedata`, so that `Deponia`, `data.vis` and `libs64` sit directly in it.
